title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — we 'sinned in Adam' when born corrupted; opponent cannot so answer
pass_a_gloss: Nothing absurd in that timing. The opponent cannot use it, because he needs Adam's act imputed from the very hour of the fall, before we existed.
pass_b_english: What absurdity is there in that? And yet the learned man could not so answer, inasmuch as he will have Adam's sin to have been imputed to us already from that time when Adam fell.
source_text: Quid in eo est absurdi? Nec tamen sic potuit respondere Vir doctus, quippe qui velit peccatum Adami nobis, iam ab eo tempore quo lapsum est Adam, fuisse imputatum.

lemmas.latin: ab eo tempore quo lapsum est Adam
lemmas.gloss: from the time when Adam fell

choices.choice: He cannot so answer; needs imputation from the fall-hour
